newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brokers lower Rhone, RPR forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Brokers lower Rhone, RPR forecasts.

text.p: Several stockbrokers have revised results forecasts downwards for Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, and some have done likewise for parent Rhone-Poulenc, after a telephone conference with analysts on Monday concerning RPR unit Centeon, fund managers said.
They said the revisions were based on slower-than-expected recovery at Centeon, an albumin producer.
Rhone-Poulenc shares were down 1.01 percent at 196.9 francs each at 1228 GMT.

SBC Warburg also changed its RPR stock recommendation to hold from buy after the share reached a target of $85 which the bank had set. Its earnings-per-share forecast for RPR was cut to $3.25 from $3.60 for 1997 and to $3.86 from $4.24 for 1998, they said.

BNP-Du Bouzet lowered to $3.50 from 3.54 in 1997 and $4.25 from $4.53 for 1998 and lowered Rhone-Poulenc to 10.10 francs from 10.70 for 1997 and to 12 francs from 12.48 francs for 1998, they said. but it remained a buyer on both stocks.

Ferri, also staying a buyer, lowered its forecasts for net earnings per share to $3.96 from $4.1 for RPR in 1997 and to $5.19 from $5.26 for 1998. It also cut for Rhone-Poulenc to 13.20 francs from 13.40 francs in 1997and to 16.4 from 16.5 francs for 1998.
